subject: [hw] DONE DEC05 rev 2: adapter now proven against DEC01 real n2ap_vdec + stand-ins (54/54); NEED_MORE_OUTPUT + share reuse
body:
DONE DEC05 rev 2. Supersedes the first DONE with the adapter integration oracle and three fixes. Host only; no phone, no publish, no commit.

Acceptance unchanged and green:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/dec/run_tests.sh
  DEC05 unit asan/o2/tsan PASS 277/277 each
  DEC05 oracle 320x240x6 PASS; 1920x1080 PASS
  DEC05 e2e asan/o2/tsan PASS 104/104 each
  DEC05 ios compile PASS (4 objects)
  N2TEST DEC05 PASS 1150/1150

New optional oracle, not part of acceptance (DEC01 owns the stand-ins, so it is a separate script):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/dec/test/run_adapter.sh
  DEC05 adapter asan PASS 54/54
  DEC05 adapter o2   PASS 54/54
  N2TEST DEC05-adapter PASS 54/54
It links daemon/dec/n2vcd_dec_ap_n2ap.c against DEC01 REAL ap/n2ap_vdec.c plus ap/test_dec01/{dec_vcu_standin,dec_hw_model,fake_daemon}.c and drives the adapter ops end to end: INIT + 2 SET_PARAM, header START (geometry 320x240/320/256/dpb 7+3/MM21), add_buffer with the single-allocation chroma (checks vsi fb_dma[1] == fb_dma[0] + 320*256), one frame START, list_disp harvest, picture/release, resolution change (free/header/new 640x480 pool/resend), flush, DEINIT, and a second session that reuses the same handles without new ion shares. This also confirms opus-hevcdec START data[0]/data[1] finding on the real library: it prints "data[0]=0x100000 data[1]=0x64 (want 0x64/0x100000)". My adapter already passes job.bs_bytes=allocation/bs_length=AU per the header, so only n2ap_vdec.c needs the swap; posted to DEC01.

Fixes since the first DONE:
1. VDEC_NEED_MORE_OUTPUT_BUF (vsi.dec.changed bit 4): the adapter retries the same input with another free reference buffer up to 3 times, then reports changed=1 instead of silently losing the AU.
2. Ion share lifetime: share ids are now mapped by handle and reused (V34 never frees a foreign share and refuses a reused id), so a long-lived daemon no longer exhausts 0x580.. after ~7 decoder sessions; 64 distinct handles is the V34 table cap (documented).
3. OPEN width/height are enforced on the stream (not just validated), and a changed START no longer leaks a picture into the queue when the model queues one.

Not done unchanged (full list in daemon/dec/STATUS.md): no phone; private include/n2vcd_proto.h still rev 1 (rev-2 text staged in /tmp; posted to lead2/hw-lead); vcodecd integration is hw-ip edit (snippet in daemon/dec/README.md); encoder+decoder concurrency untested; MM21 only; nonzero crop origin refused; dpb_frames capped at 16; resolution change on the real vendor is [I]; write-combining must be enabled by the daemon.

Files changed since rev 1: daemon/dec/n2vcd_dec_ap_n2ap.c, daemon/dec/n2vcd_dec_service.c, daemon/dec/test/{t_adapter.c,run_adapter.sh,fake_ap.c,t_dec_unit.c}, daemon/dec/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/DEC05/STATUS.md. Staying available for R1/R2/lead findings.
